result.summary: Test a narrow monitoring-and-alert offer for local businesses with active Google profiles: review spikes, new feedback, and ranking shifts, sold as a small 30-day pilot instead of a generic dashboard.
result.opportunity: Local businesses actively rely on Google Business Profiles and reviews to win new customers, but many do not monitor review changes, sentiment, or local ranking shifts in real time. A simple alerting service is cheaper and faster to sell than a broad analytics SaaS.
result.target_customer: Small local service businesses in Spain/Europe with an active Google Business Profile and at least 2-20 employees: clinics, dental offices, locksmiths, gyms, beauty salons, legal firms, and home services.
result.offer: A 30-day GBP review and local rank monitoring pilot: daily monitoring of new reviews, sentiment risk, competitor changes, and a weekly summary with suggested review replies and local SEO priorities.
result.why_now: BrightLocal's 2026 survey reports that 97% of consumers read reviews for local businesses and that 41% always read reviews when looking for a business. Google Business Profile is a primary discovery channel for local customers, and slow or generic responses are increasingly seen as a red flag. This supports a real, current demand for monitoring and timely reactions.
actions_completed: Reviewed the monetization playbook route #4: Monitoring and alert service.
Checked the real market signal: Google Business Profiles and review-driven local discovery.
Validated that the offer can be narrowed to a specific, low-cost pilot instead of a broad SaaS dashboard.
Prepared a concrete execution packet with a low-friction first sale in mind.

execution_packet.channel: Email outreach to businesses using publicly listed contact details on their websites or Google Business Profile; optionally LinkedIn messages only to businesses with a public company page.
execution_packet.subject: GBP review and local ranking alert pilot para tu negocio
execution_packet.message: Hola, estoy probando un servicio muy concreto para negocios locales con perfil en Google: monitorizo nuevas reseñas, cambios de reputación y movimientos de posición local, y te envío un resumen semanal con alertas y respuestas sugeridas. La idea es un piloto de 30 días para ver si reduce la fricción de atender feedback y proteger tu visibilidad local. El proyecto se ofrece con referencia RANK-IAMO484. Si te interesa, puedo enviar una demo corta y una propuesta con el alcance exacto. El pago puede gestionarse en https://cobramo.netlify.app/.
execution_packet.deliverable: 30-day alert monitor packaged as a Google Sheet/Airtable dashboard plus a weekly email summary and suggested response templates for review issues and local ranking changes.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I chose route #4 instead of a generic report or AI template product because the evidence points to a real pain: review and visibility management is directly tied to customer acquisition, and the offer can be delivered as a small pilot without building a full platform. This is narrower and more evidence-based than the generic SaaS or affiliate patterns seen in nearby attempts.
result.next_step: Contact 20 local businesses with active Google profiles and a public website, offer a 30-day GBP review alert pilot, and close the first paid pilot before expanding features or pricing.
result.notes: Seed routes considered: #4 Monitoring and alert service fit the evidence best; #24 prompt pack was less direct for a first sale; #44 Ko-fi shop and #64 niche review site need more distribution and less immediate B2B demand; #84 is legitimate but outside the target market and requires strict scope. The selected path is a bounded pilot around a real business signal, not a broad SaaS gamble. Evidence from BrightLocal and Google Business Profile indicates current demand for review monitoring and local discovery behavior.
